nodes.label: Validator String Parsing Bug
nodes.rationale: Disabling output repair must not disable JSON parsing; otherwise validators call dict methods on a raw string.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Prompt Pattern
nodes.rationale: Constrain LLM tasks with role, exact JSON schema, examples, preservation rules, citations, and output-only instructions.

nodes.label: Unified Diagnostic Logging
nodes.rationale: LLM I/O should propagate through the root logger into the shared debug log instead of a dedicated file.

nodes.label: LangGraph Node-Service Boundary
nodes.rationale: Nodes belong to workflow structure and read or update state; services are reusable helper logic called by nodes.

nodes.label: Answer Pipeline Node Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Draft generation, answer-quality checking, and auto-distillation should be separate conditional graph nodes.

nodes.label: Global Async Query Lock
nodes.rationale: A process-wide lock held for the entire handler serializes otherwise concurrent API requests.

nodes.label: FIFO LLM Rate-Limit Gate
nodes.rationale: A FIFO gate, token-reset deadline, and adaptive cooldown coordinate calls, but SDK-internal retries can hold and bypass the intended control loop.

nodes.label: MongoDB-Backed Application Stores
nodes.rationale: Replace JSON and JSONL persistence with dedicated MongoDB store classes while retaining Chroma for vector storage.

nodes.label: Query Variant Pre-Filtering
nodes.rationale: Remove exact, normalized, previously failed, and embedding-similar variants before graph fan-out to avoid full redundant branches.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Retrieval Tuning
nodes.rationale: Tune top-k and similarity thresholds using production score distributions, rank decay, and downstream validation rather than theoretical defaults.

nodes.label: Task-Specific Small-Model Routing
nodes.rationale: Keep user-facing generation on the existing Groq model and route high-volume structured judge tasks to smaller free local or alternative-provider models.

nodes.label: LangfuseHandler (log-to-Langfuse mirror)
nodes.rationale: Langfuse SDK imported lazily and all emit errors swallowed so a telemetry backend can never break application logging; a ContextVar re-entry guard prevents infinite log loops.

nodes.label: get_or_create_learned_qa_collection (cosine migration)
nodes.rationale: An older L2 learned-QA index is migrated to cosine by snapshotting to a uuid backup collection, restoring, count-verifying, and rolling back on any failure so a partial migration can never corrupt the store.

nodes.label: FIFO call gate + adaptive cooldown
nodes.rationale: A queue.Queue of per-thread Events gives strict arrival-order fairness; a thread that gets a 429 holds the gate and retries at the front rather than re-enqueueing. A global token-reset deadline is paid once per exhaustion event, and an adaptive inter-call cooldown floor derived from Groq x-ratelimit headers doubles after a 429-recovery and halves after 3 clean successes to avoid draining the token window. Jitter is omitted because the gate guarantees only one call at a time.

nodes.label: LLMResult container + LLMErrorKind taxonomy
nodes.rationale: A single result dataclass carries either success content or a structured error kind so callers branch on a normalized taxonomy instead of catching provider-specific exceptions; tool_use_failed 400s recover partial generation text via _strip_function_suffix.

nodes.label: Groq httpx response-header capture hook
nodes.rationale: LangChain's ChatGroq wrapper does not propagate raw HTTP rate-limit headers into AIMessage.response_metadata, so an httpx event hook is installed on the underlying Groq client to capture x-ratelimit-* headers directly; safe because the FIFO gate ensures only one call runs at a time.

nodes.label: setup_logging (central logging config)
nodes.rationale: Root logging is configured once per process with a request-id ContextVar filter and a dynamic-stdout handler that follows sys.stdout so batch-run tee streams still capture console logs.

nodes.label: _TracingHandler (mirror logs to LangSmith/Phoenix)
nodes.rationale: Log records are mirrored onto the active LangSmith run and the Phoenix/OTel span; Phoenix spans are looked up by LangChain run_id (reused from LangSmith's run_tree) because OpenInferenceTracer keys spans by run_id rather than the ambient current-span context.

nodes.label: traced_operation decorator
nodes.rationale: Wraps a function in a RunnableLambda so the resulting LangChain run is shared by Langfuse, LangSmith, and Phoenix; observability failures in the output builder are swallowed so a successful app operation never fails because of tracing.

nodes.label: instrument_namespace (module auto-tracing hook)
nodes.rationale: Every service module calls this at import time to apply the central tracing policy to all its module-level functions and class methods, keeping trace naming and input/output shaping in one file.

nodes.label: TraceSpec input/output policy registry
nodes.rationale: A central _TRACE_SPECS/_GROUP_SPECS registry bounds and shapes trace payloads (truncating text, summarizing collections, redacting client/handler service objects) so credentials and huge object graphs never enter the trace.

nodes.label: RAGRetriever (dual-collection retrieval)
nodes.rationale: Retrieves documents and learned-QA as two independent ranked lists (retrieve_separate) with per-collection thresholds; each ChromaDB query runs in a single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor with a timeout so a stalled collection is skipped rather than hanging the request. similarity_score is computed as 1 - cosine distance.

nodes.label: SelfLearner (feedback distillation)
nodes.rationale: Distills good feedback interactions into learned-QA pairs every learn_every_n good interactions; QA pairs are deduplicated by a sha256-derived stable id before upsert so re-running distillation never inserts duplicates.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_SWITCHES (ENABLE_* toggles)
nodes.rationale: Per-request ENABLE_* overrides are resolved once onto config.py defaults and stored on GraphState['switches']; unknown keys and non-bool values are ignored so a malformed request cannot corrupt a run.

nodes.label: TimingTracker (per-stage durations)
nodes.rationale: Thread-safe accumulator of per-category stage durations flushed to a JSON sidecar next to the debug log; wired to the debug file path by setup_logging.

nodes.label: validate_merge (fabrication/drop judge)
nodes.rationale: Verdict is derived from the LLM's fabricated_claims/dropped_claims lists (any fabrication or drop => UNFAITHFUL) rather than trusting a free-text verdict, guarding against hallucinated merge approvals.

nodes.label: validate_redundancy (DC group judge)
nodes.rationale: Any group the judge does not explicitly CONFIRM defaults to REJECTED (safe default): on LLM error, invalid JSON, or out-of-range group_index all groups are treated as REJECTED so no chunk is wrongly removed.

nodes.label: VectorStore (documents collection)
nodes.rationale: A persistent ChromaDB cosine collection; metadata values are sanitized (non-primitive values JSON-encoded) before add, and batch inserts clear CUDA cache between batches to bound GPU memory.

nodes.label: GraphState (LangGraph shared state)
nodes.rationale: Per-track chunk lists (raw, validated, dedup-merged, compressed) are kept separate for the documents and learned-QA tracks and only combined after both parallel tracks finish; operator.add reducers accumulate results across parallel retrieve branches.

nodes.label: Docling loader
nodes.rationale: Kept as a strong primary multi-format parser because it preserves layout, hierarchy, reading order, tables, formulas, and metadata in one document model; can silently return a partial document after page-level std::bad_alloc failures (BUG-009).

nodes.label: Unstructured loader
nodes.rationale: Partitions PDFs into typed elements mapped to Markdown by a deliberately lightweight local adapter (Title/Header/ListItem only); requires the [pdf] extra for unstructured_inference.

nodes.label: Marker PDF loader
nodes.rationale: Model-backed PDF converter chosen for text-centric extraction; high aggregate word retention does not prove structural completeness (BUG-011), it does not export image assets and produces mojibake (BUG-010), and it flattens nested list pointers to one indentation level (BUG-012).

nodes.label: temp_split() Markdown chunker
nodes.rationale: A hand-authored, top-to-bottom boundary-selection splitter (uncommitted) built from an explicit rule set rather than heading-level recursion; tables are atomic, flat lists split one item at a time with lead-ins preserved, no overlap, and correctness is guarded by a full round-trip no-loss check across all four local documents.

nodes.label: preprocessing() clause-normalization pass (ADR-007)
nodes.rationale: In-memory normalization runs before temp_split() and never rewrites the on-disk Marker Markdown, chosen over disk rewriting (destroys audit trail) and boundary-only soft-heading detection (cannot rejoin fragmented clause bodies). Font size/weight heading signal is gone from Marker output and bold is overloaded for inline defined terms, so whole-line anchoring is the safeguard against false headings. Refines but does not override the 'chunking is not a repair mechanism' principle.

nodes.label: Routed production ingestion (researched, not implemented)
nodes.rationale: Research topic 3 recommends avoiding a single universal parser: inspect each file, route ordinary PDFs to a fast parser (PyMuPDF4LLM), use Docling for structured content, OCR for scans (PaddleOCR/OCRmyPDF), Apache Tika as broad fallback, preserve page/section metadata, and quarantine low-confidence parses. No router, confidence model, or quarantine exists in the repo.

nodes.label: Per-loader Python 3.12 environment isolation (ADR-005)
nodes.rationale: Marker 1.10.2 requires Pillow <11 while Unstructured 0.24.1's pi-heif needs Pillow >=11.1, so a combined environment is unsatisfiable; three isolated .venvs preserve the comparison baseline versions. Python 3.12 was chosen over 3.14 for prebuilt Windows wheels of the regex/native ML stack (ADR-002).

nodes.label: Marker structural-fidelity defects
nodes.rationale: Marker corrupts table row associations, drops page furniture/TOC pagination, reorders and duplicates content near dense cross-page tables (BUG-011), flattens nested list pointers to one level (BUG-012), and omits image assets while introducing mojibake (BUG-010); chunking must not be treated as a repair for these source-conversion defects.

nodes.label: langgraph_api timing metrics (per-stage durations)
nodes.rationale: A TimingTracker JSON sidecar recording per-category stage durations for one langgraph_api run; retrieval-validation dominates (tens of seconds per call) versus sub-second DB retrieval, evidencing the LLM-judge validators as the pipeline's cost center.
